lines.en: Good evening. Can I help you?
Yes, please. **I’ve lost my** backpack. I think I left it on the train.
lines.pt: Sim, por favor. Perdi minha mochila. Acho que deixei no trem.

lines.en: It’s a medium green backpack with a small black logo, and there’s a yellow keychain on the zipper.
lines.pt: É uma mochila média verde, com um pequeno logotipo preto e um chaveiro amarelo no zíper.
Certo. E o que tinha dentro?

lines.en: My laptop, a water bottle and a blue notebook. My name is inside the notebook.
lines.pt: Meu notebook, uma garrafa de água e um caderno azul. Meu nome está dentro do caderno.

lines.en: **Where did you last see it?** And what time was that?
lines.pt: Onde você a viu pela última vez? E que horas eram?

lines.en: On the five-fifteen train from Portland, in the second car. I got off around six.
lines.pt: No trem das cinco e quinze de Portland, no segundo vagão. Desci por volta das seis.

lines.en: Let me check. Please fill out this form with your phone number. We’ll call you if we find it.
lines.pt: Vou verificar. Preencha este formulário com seu telefone. Ligaremos se a encontrarmos.

lines.en: Thank you so much. I hope it turns up soon!
lines.pt: Muito obrigada. Espero que apareça logo!

pages.title: Lost and found

situation.text: You left your backpack on a train. At the station’s lost-and-found counter, you describe the bag and what is inside so the clerk can look for it.

pages.goal: By the end of the class you can report a lost item, describe it, say where and when you lost it, and understand what to do next.
canDo: Report the loss: I’ve lost my…
Describe the item: color, size and what is inside
Say where and when you last saw it
Understand the next step and give your contact information
success: I give my contact details and thank the clerk.
pages.think: Have you ever lost something important? How did you try to find it?

teach.goal: Abrir a aula pela situação real (achados e perdidos), não pela regra.
solo: Leia o objetivo em voz alta e peça que o estudante diga com as próprias palavras o que vai conseguir fazer hoje.
Faça a pergunta “Think about it” e deixe-o responder em português antes de mostrar qualquer expressão.
group: Cada estudante diz UMA palavra ou frase que associa à situação.
Mostre os 4 critérios de sucesso: eles são a missão final da aula.
extra: What would be the worst thing to lose when you travel?
How do you keep track of your things?
support: Aceite respostas curtas ou em português na primeira rodada e reformule em inglês, devagar.

pages.title: Connection & warm-up

intro.solo: Start with real questions about the student’s life, not a grammar test.
intro.group: One question per student, then each student asks a classmate a follow-up.

pages.recall: Customer service calls (lesson 84): “Could I have your…?”, spelling. Ask: How do you spell your name in English?

qs.q: What do you carry every day?
qs.pt: O que você carrega todos os dias?

qs.q: Have you ever lost something on public transport?
qs.pt: Você já perdeu algo no transporte público?

qs.q: Do you have a place for your keys at home?
qs.pt: Você tem um lugar para as chaves em casa?

pages.tip: Use the answers to find gaps. Recycle the earlier unit content; the goal is to be in English from the first minute.

teach.goal: Entrar no idioma no primeiro minuto e preparar o tema da aula.
extra: Do you leave your name on your things?
Have you ever found something that belonged to someone else?

errors.w: I forgot my keys in home.
errors.r: I left my keys at home.

errors.w: I have lost my keys yesterday.

support: Ofereça as respostas-modelo (chips) e peça apenas que escolham uma e a ampliem com “because…”.

pages.title: Cultural snapshot — Public Places in the USA
pages.intro: Train and bus stations often have a lost-and-found service. Look at the cards: what does the clerk need to know?

cards.note: Clerks usually ask for color, size, brand and special details, like a name tag or a scratch.
The time, the train or bus and the place help the staff find the right item faster.
You usually leave your phone or email. To pick up an item, you may need to describe it correctly or show ID.

qs.q: What does a lost-and-found clerk ask?

levels.A2: What does it look like? Where did you last see it?
levels.B1: They ask for a description and the time and place you lost it.
levels.B2: A clerk needs a precise description plus the time and place so they can match it with items handed in.

qs.q: What details help describe a bag?
qs.pt: Que detalhes ajudam a descrever uma bolsa?

levels.A2: Color, size, brand and what is inside.
levels.B1: Color, size, material, brand, any marks and the contents.
levels.B2: Distinguishing features, such as a keychain or a repaired zipper, make the description far more reliable.

qs.q: What can you leave for the clerk?
qs.pt: O que deixar para o atendente?

levels.A2: My name, phone number or email.
levels.B1: Contact details so they can call if the item arrives.
levels.B2: Reliable contact information so that staff can reach you as soon as the item is located.

pages.compare: In Brazil, lost items are often reported at a station office or to a security guard, and people may rely on social media for help. In the USA, official lost-and-found desks and forms are common. How do people look for lost items where you live?

teach.goal: Ativar o contexto cultural e levantar hipóteses antes do diálogo.
solo: Mostre os 3 cartões e peça hipóteses antes de explicar.
Peça que o estudante compare com o que acontece no Brasil.
group: Cada estudante escolhe um cartão e explica em uma frase.
Pergunte “Do you agree?” entre colegas.
answers: Q3: nome e telefone ou e-mail.
extra: Where do you go to report lost things in your country?
Would you return a lost wallet?
support: Use as respostas do nível A1 como andaime e peça que repitam em voz alta.
stretch: B2: compare convenções de cortesia no atendimento no Brasil e nos EUA.

teach.goal: Compreender a situação antes de ver o texto: ideia principal e depois os detalhes.
solo: Esconda o texto. 1ª escuta: só a ideia principal.
2ª escuta: preencha as informações pedidas.
Mostre o texto só depois da 2ª escuta.
group: Escuta coletiva; duplas anotam as respostas antes de revelar.
Compare as respostas entre as duplas e só então mostre o texto.
answers: Pass 2: backpack · green · laptop · train · phone number
support: Use o botão “Slow” na 2ª escuta e pause após cada fala.

qs.q: What does the clerk ask her to do?

retell.prompt: Retell the conversation in your own words, at your level.
starters: The clerk asks where and when…

teach.goal: Ler o diálogo, perceber os chunks em negrito e recontar a situação.
solo: O estudante lê um papel; você lê o outro. Troquem.
Peça que reconte a conversa no nível que conseguir.
group: Leitura em duplas com troca de papéis.
Reconto em cadeia: uma frase por estudante.
answers: A green backpack · yellow keychain · laptop, bottle and notebook · five-fifteen train · form with phone number
extra: Why does the clerk ask for the time?
What else could the clerk ask?

errors.w: I lost my bag in the train.
errors.r: I lost my bag on the train.

support: Mostre a tradução (botão PT) depois da 2ª leitura.

pages.title: Useful expressions

items.use: The clerk asks for a description.

items.en: Where did you last see it?
items.pt: Onde você viu pela última vez?
items.use: The clerk asks where you lost it.
items.alt: Also: **When did you notice it was missing?**

items.en: I think I left it on…

items.use: The clerk gives you a form.

items.en: Where did you last see it?
It’s a green bag with a keychain.

pages.note: Instead of memorizing the whole list, choose 3–5 expressions (★) to use again and again. The others are for understanding and for stretching later.

teach.goal: Escolher 3–5 chunks para uso repetido e descobrir a função de cada um.
solo: Pergunte “When do you say it?” antes de dar a tradução.
Compare as versões formal e informal e peça um exemplo da vida real do estudante.
group: Cada estudante escolhe a expressão que mais usaria e explica quando.
Compare equivalentes formais e informais em duplas.
answers: Report the loss · Clerk asks for a description · Clerk asks where and when · Describe the item · Next step
extra: Which expression do you need first when you lose something?

errors.r: Where did you last see it?

support: Trabalhe só as expressões ★ nesta aula; as demais ficam para compreensão.

patterns.name: Reporting a loss
ex: I’ve lost my phone on the bus.

patterns.name: Describing an item
ex: It’s a small black wallet with a zipper.
It’s a medium green backpack with a keychain.

patterns.name: Saying where and when
ex: I last saw it on the train.
I last saw it at six o’clock.

swap.frame: I’ve lost my {item}. It’s {desc}, and I last saw it {place}.
swap.tpt: Perdi {item}. É {desc}, e vi pela última vez {place}.

head: Spoken English
Written English
rows: I am reporting a lost bag.
Could you please describe the item?
I last saw it on the train.
The item was last seen on the train.
We will contact you if it is found.
register.note: These are differences of context and register, not absolute rules: contractions also appear in informal writing.

teach.goal: Fixar os 2 padrões principais; os outros são expansão. Usar a troca de palavras para variar a fala.
solo: Mostre o padrão DENTRO do diálogo (grife os chunks).
Use “Swap the words”: toque em cada peça e peça a frase completa em voz alta.
Compare spoken × written em 2 exemplos.
group: Troca em cadeia: cada estudante muda UMA peça e o próximo repete a frase.
Em pares: um escolhe as peças, o outro fala.
teach.answers: Padrões 01 e 02 são o foco; 03 e 04 são expansão.
extra: Change one word and say the new sentence.

errors.w: There is a laptop in inside.
I’ve lost my wallet in the bus.
errors.r: I’ve lost my wallet on the bus.

support: Fique só com o primeiro padrão na primeira rodada.
stretch: Combine dois padrões na mesma fala, como em uma conversa real.

pages.title: Pronunciation lab — natural American English
pages.tip: In a description, the strong words are adjectives and nouns: “a MEdium GREEN BACKpack”. Small words like a and with are weak.

items.say: There’s a yellow keychain on it.
items.linked: There’s a YEL·low KEY·chain on it.

own.prompt: Describe an object you carry every day in one sentence.
own.criteria: Say it twice: with all words equal, then with strong adjectives and nouns. Which is clearer?

teach.goal: UM só fenômeno: sentence stress in descriptions.
solo: 3 passagens: escutar e identificar → reproduzir ritmo e entonação → usar em frase com conteúdo próprio.
Modele devagar e em velocidade normal; peça que o estudante bata palmas na sílaba forte.
group: Coro, depois duplas; circule ouvindo.
Cada estudante cria uma frase própria usando o fenômeno.
answers: Identify: It’s a small black bag. · It’s a green backpack.

errors.w: todas as palavras com a mesma força
errors.r: adjetivo e substantivo fortes: GREEN BACKpack

support: Reduza a velocidade e conte as batidas em voz alta.

levels.h: Controlled practice — choose the best answer

items.q: 1. You lost your wallet. What do you say?
opts: I lost the wallet of me.

items.q: 2. The clerk asks “What does it look like?”.
3. The clerk asks about time and place.
opts: I last saw it on the train.

items.q: 4. The clerk wants to contact you.

levels.h: Guided practice — complete, substitute and transform

items.text: It’s a small black bag ___ a zipper.

ans: I’ve lost my wallet on the bus.
I lost my wallet on the bus.
I left my wallet on the bus.
items.model: I’ve lost my wallet on the bus.

ans: It’s a green bag with a keychain.
It’s a green bag with a keychain
items.model: It’s a green bag with a keychain.
items.why: It’s a + color + noun + with + detail.

items.npc: Where did you last see it?
opts: On the five-fifteen train, I think.
I last saw me in train.
items.why: Name the place and add I think when you are not sure.

teach.goal: Do controlado ao guiado: escolher, completar, transformar e responder antes da fala livre.
solo: Peça que o estudante justifique cada resposta.
Se acertar rápido, peça a versão mais informal ou mais educada.
group: Resolvam em duplas e comparem antes de revelar.
Equipes: um ponto por resposta justificada.
answers: 1: I’ve lost my wallet. · 2: It’s a small black wallet. · 3: I last saw it on the train. · 4: Here’s my phone number.
Gap: lost · with · I’ve lost my wallet on the bus. · It’s a green bag with a keychain. · On the five-fifteen train, I think.
extra: Say each correct answer with strong adjectives and nouns.
support: Ofereça o banco de palavras (chips) nas lacunas.

pages.title: Personalized roleplay — find it again

brief.teacher: You are the lost-and-found clerk (change the plan during the scene!).
brief.student: You are the traveler: report a lost item and describe it.

orders: A green backpack left on a train
A black wallet lost at a bus stop
A blue umbrella left in a café
complications: You don’t remember exactly where you lost it.
The clerk says there are two similar bags.
You do not have your phone number memorized.
The item has not been turned in yet.
success: I give my contact details and thank the clerk.

teach.goal: Simulação com complicação inesperada e três rodadas com menos apoio.
solo: Combine o cenário com a vida do estudante (uma situação parecida que ele já viveu).
Rodada 1: com chunks. Rodada 2: só palavras-chave. Rodada 3: sem roteiro.
Meta de fala: 60–70% do tempo para o estudante. Anote 2–3 correções para a devolutiva.
extra: What if the clerk cannot find it? What do you say?

errors.r: Could you look for my bag, please?

support: Volte à rodada 1 se travar; peça que repita só a primeira frase.
stretch: Peça que o estudante inverta o papel e conduza a conversa como o atendente.

rounds.title: Report the loss
rounds.task: Say what you lost and where. Your partner is the clerk.
rounds.hint: I’ve lost my… / I think I left it…

rounds.title: Describe it
rounds.task: Describe the item with color, size and details. Ask follow-up questions.
rounds.hint: It’s a… with… / What does it look like?

rounds.title: Check and match
rounds.task: The clerk checks the list. Say if it is yours or not.
rounds.hint: Yes, that’s mine. / No, mine is…

rounds.title: Share solutions
rounds.task: Whole group: which description was clearest?

infogap.title: Lost property list
infogap.instr: Ask your partner and complete your card. Do not look at the other card!

a.title: Traveler
a.task: You know what the bag looks like. Ask about the rest.

b.title: Clerk
b.task: You know where it was found and when to pick up. Ask about the rest.

teach.goal: Fluência por repetição da função com informações novas a cada rodada.
group: Troque os pares a cada rodada (A+B / C+D → A+C / B+D → A+D / B+C → grupo todo). Com 6 estudantes, três duplas simultâneas.
Sem salas simultâneas: interações sequenciais enquanto uma dupla apresenta.
Responsabilidade individual: cada aluno faz ≥1 pergunta e ≥1 resposta.
answers: A tem Item: backpack e Color: green; B tem Found at: Platform 3 e Pick up: tomorrow at nine. Cada um completa o cartão perguntando.
extra: How can you describe a bag with only five words?
support: Entregue frases-modelo no chat da turma.

pages.title: Group mission — find it again
pages.goal: Each group must get something done in English: report, describe and agree on the next step.

missions.mission: You left a black wallet on a bus. Describe it and say where and when you last saw it.
missions.constraint: Use “I’ve lost my…” and “It’s a… with…”

missions.mission: You lost a small red bag at the station. Say what is inside and give your phone number.
missions.start: Excuse me. I think I left…

missions.mission: Your umbrella is missing. The clerk has two umbrellas. Describe yours so the clerk can match it.

success: I give my contact details and thank the clerk.

teach.goal: Realizar algo com o inglês: o objetivo é resolver, não só falar certo.
group: Cada grupo recebe papel, restrição e missão. Alterne os papéis.
Progressão: 1ª rodada com frases de apoio, 2ª só palavras-chave, 3ª sem roteiro.
Observe e anote 2–3 correções prioritárias; devolutiva no fim.
answers: Modelo: “I’ve lost my wallet.” → “What does it look like?” → “It’s a small black wallet with a zipper. I last saw it on the bus.”
extra: What if two items look the same?
support: Dê o início de frase (“Start with”) em cada cartão.

pages.title: Writing — a small real-life task
pages.task: Write a short lost-and-found message: describe a missing item and say where you lost it.
pages.model: Hello! **I’ve lost my blue umbrella.** **It’s a large umbrella with a wooden handle.** **I last saw it** in the café on Pine Street on Friday afternoon. My phone number is 555-0142. Thank you!
checklist: I described it and said where I last saw it.
I gave my contact and thanked them.
pages.tip: Fix only 2–3 priority points. Show a more natural way to say the same idea instead of rewriting everything.

teach.goal: Produção escrita curta ligada à situação comunicativa.
solo: Peça a mensagem; corrija 2–3 pontos prioritários e mostre uma forma mais natural.
group: Cada estudante escreve; depois troquem os textos entre colegas e corrijam em duplas.
extra: Add the date you lost it.

errors.w: I lost my umbrella since Friday.
errors.r: I lost my umbrella on Friday.

support: Dê o modelo e peça só para trocar os dados.

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.desc: Mantém a comunicação sem interrupções excessivas.

criteria.name: Language use
criteria.desc: Utiliza adequadamente padrões, vocabulário e expressões.

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.desc: É compreensível e usa ritmo e entonação adequados.

criteria.name: Interaction
criteria.desc: Responde, pergunta, esclarece e desenvolve a conversa.

interpret.text: Needs more support. Revisit the main patterns with guided practice before the next lesson.
Functional performance. Work on the lowest criteria in the next lesson.
Good control. Raise complexity and speed; add follow-up questions.
Strong performance. Move to a more demanding situation.

prompts.well: Example: You described the item clearly and said where you last saw it.
prompts.improve: Example: Stress adjectives and nouns, not small words.
prompts.next: Example: Report a lost item and answer all the clerk’s questions, without notes.

teach.goal: Avaliar o que o aluno conseguiu comunicar, não só os erros gramaticais.
solo: O estudante se autoavalia primeiro; depois você.
Feche com os três blocos: What you did well · What to improve · Your next challenge.
group: Dê um comentário por critério a cada estudante.
Cada um escolhe o próprio próximo desafio.
teach.answers: A rubrica é uma ferramenta interna de acompanhamento, não uma certificação CEFR.

tasks.model: It’s a small black wallet with a zipper.

items: Record a 45–60 second audio reporting a lost item.
Write a short description of your own bag or backpack.
Draw an object and describe it in three sentences.
Listen to the dialogue again and underline two expressions.

next: Where did you last see it?

teach.goal: Toda aula termina com uma produção observável.
solo: Sem consultar as anotações: construir uma pergunta, responder a uma situação e usar uma expressão nova.
group: Exit challenge individual; compare com o colega e combine a tarefa de continuidade.
answers: I’ve lost my wallet. · It’s a small black wallet with a zipper. · I last saw it on the train.
extra: Revisão espaçada: retomar na próxima aula, depois de uma semana e na missão de encerramento da unidade.

pages.title: Level up — the same situation from A1 to C2
pages.intro: You do not need six different methods: the structure stays, while language complexity and autonomy grow.

ladder.goal: Short words with a clear need.

ladder.say: I’ve lost my green backpack. I last saw it on the train.
I think I left my backpack on the five-fifteen train. It’s green, and there’s a laptop inside.
ladder.goal: Give more detail about the situation.

ladder.say: I must have left it in the second car, because I noticed it was missing as soon as I got off.
Since it contains important work documents, I’d be very grateful if you could notify me as soon as it’s found.
I’d be indebted to you if it could be located; its contents are of little value to anyone but me.

pages.note: This progression is illustrative: complex sentences do not define a level on their own. CEFR also considers comprehension, autonomy, fluency, accuracy, interaction and appropriateness.

teach.goal: Mostrar a progressão sem criar seis metodologias.
solo: Mostre onde o estudante está (A2) e a próxima etapa.
group: Cada um escolhe a frase do próprio nível e a do próximo.
